hints.title: Inorder is sorted
hints.body: An inorder traversal of a BST visits values in ascending order.

hints.title: Stop early
hints.body: You only need the first `k` visited nodes, not the whole tree.

hints.title: Iterative stack
hints.body: Push all left descendants, pop one node, then move to its right subtree.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
stack = []
node = root
remaining = k
while stack or node:
    while node:
        push node
        node = node.left
    node = pop()
    remaining -= 1
    if remaining == 0: return node.value
    node = node.right
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
